name: Crossmint
description: Payment infrastructure for agents: card vaults with user-approved spending limits, stablecoin agent wallets for x402 and MPP, and one API to check out on any website. Plus the lobster.cash CLI.

skills.name: Hold Funds in Agent Wallet
skills.description: Creates non-custodial stablecoin wallets that users fund with a card and that an agent spends from as a delegated signer.

skills.name: Pay with x402
skills.description: Pays x402-protected and MPP endpoints from a Crossmint wallet so an agent can buy API calls per request.

skills.name: Set Agent Spend Limits
skills.description: Lets a user save a card once and approve an order intent, a spending limit the agent can pay within many times.

skills.name: Check Out on Any Merchant
skills.description: Starts an agent checkout to buy, manage a cart or a subscription on any website under a spending cap, with streamed status.
